review_type: supplemental post hoc blinded qualitative text review
blinding: Choices retained only as anonymous A and B. No identity, audit key, experiment result, source repository, external service, or other reviewer material inspected.
scope: Selected cases only; no unweighted population accuracy claim. This does not replace the separate preregistered paid review.

fit_definitions.supported: A defensible fit to the literal text and matching catalog without adding essential unstated context; need not be uniquely best.
fit_definitions.unsupported: No sufficient textual subject cue, a contradictory catalog boundary, or an unjustified Other despite a recognizable supplied subject.
fit_definitions.unclear: Plausible but not established because wording, essential context, or catalog boundaries are unresolved.

preference_definitions.A: A is better supported than B; this need not establish a uniquely correct category.
preference_definitions.B: B is better supported than A; this need not establish a uniquely correct category.
preference_definitions.both: Both are defensible; this can include identical choices or unresolved catalog overlap.
preference_definitions.neither: Neither anonymous choice is defensible, with a different category established.
preference_definitions.unclear: The text or catalog does not permit a reliable preference.

best_category_fields: best_category_id uses the category IDs within catalog_id. Null with best_category_status Other is a defensible rejection; null with unresolved is a withheld unique best label, not an assertion that no catalog category could fit.

severity_definitions.none: No classification problem established for the choices under review.
severity_definitions.minor: A close boundary, reasonable competing reading, or incompletely specified description; no strong error claim.
severity_definitions.major: At least one clearly unsupported broad routing or rejection; does not measure downstream harm.
severity_definitions.unclear: The available text does not support a reliable severity judgment.

equal_choice_review: All 12 equal-choice cases were checked against the actual utterance and matching catalog, including the four equal Other cases. No clear shared mistake was established; specialist-provider, personal-advice, and acknowledgment coverage remain boundary questions.
selection_warning: The case selection is post hoc and enriched for disagreements and selected agreements. Counts below describe this review set only and cannot estimate either anonymous system's population accuracy.
